steps.title: Configure App Meta and Specifications
steps.description: Establish the global namespace, package name: com.real3dcaradventure.app, and custom game name 'Real3DCarAdventure'.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml specifying a landscape-oriented hardware-accelerated Game Activity with required GL configurations.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper compile and target SDKs (34), tool versions, and strict Java 8 compilation compatibility.

steps.title: Create HUD Panel Background
steps.description: Create a translucent glass-morphism style background with an electric-cyan border for the HUD panels.

steps.title: Create Steering Button Backgrounds
steps.description: Create custom rounded shapes for the steering buttons to match the sleek futuristic neon theme.

steps.title: Create Gas and Brake Pedal Backgrounds
steps.description: Create custom green and red gradient rounded backgrounds for the Gas and Brake pedals.

steps.title: Design Cyberpunk HUD User Interface
steps.description: Assemble a full-screen layout featuring digital meters, gear indicators, an interactive RPM progress bar, control buttons, and a sensor mode toggle.

steps.title: Initialize Dynamic Audio Engine
steps.description: Implement a real-time programmatic audio synthesizer using AudioTrack in MainActivity to play dynamic, variable-frequency engine sound based on throttle and current speed.

steps.title: Implement Accelerometer Sensor Steering
steps.description: Code and register hardware sensor listeners for tilt-steering with standard landscape configuration and speed-sensitive scaling.

steps.title: Construct 3D Scenic Architectural Buildings
steps.description: Define vertex transformations and drawing functions to render 3D skyscrapers with illuminated neon glass window stripes.

steps.title: Program Interactive Running Traffic Cars
steps.description: Upgrade obstacle spawners to spawn dynamic cars possessing individual forward/reverse velocities based on lane directions.

steps.title: Synchronize Rendering and Logic Threads
steps.description: Establish synchronized locks on game arrays to resolve ConcurrentModificationException crashes at high speeds.

steps.title: Building Real3DCarAdventure
steps.description: Build the complete debug APK, compile the shader programs, and verify perfect rendering stability.
